CK_WAKE.en: Call the child's name, touch gently, do not shake. Reply 1 if they do not wake, do not look at you, or drift off while you talk. 2 awake and alert. 3 not sure.
CK_WAKE.sw: Ita jina la mtoto, mguse polepole. Usimtikise. Jibu 1 haamki, hakuangalii, au analala ukiongea. 2 yuko macho na makini. 3 sina uhakika
CK_WAKE.bt: Call the child’s name, touch them gently. Do not shake them. Reply 1 does not wake up, does not look at you, or falls asleep while you are talking. 2 is awake and alert. 3 I am not sure

CK_BLOOD.en: Look at the child's last stool (poo). Reply 1 if you see blood or red. 2 no blood. 3 not sure or no stool.
CK_BLOOD.sw: Angalia kinyesi cha mwisho cha mtoto. Jibu 1 ukiona damu au rangi nyekundu. 2 hakuna damu. 3 sina uhakika au hakuna kinyesi.
CK_BLOOD.bt: Check the child's last stool. Reply 1 if you see blood or red color. 2 no blood. 3 I am not sure or there is no stool.

Q_ACK_TOLD.en: Thank you, your answer was passed on. If no one calls or comes within {minutes} minutes, go to {facility}. Go NOW if a danger sign appears.
Q_ACK_TOLD.sw: Asante, jibu lako limefikishwa. Mtu asipopiga simu au kuja ndani ya dakika {minutes}, nenda {facility}. Ukiona dalili ya hatari, nenda SASA HIVI.
Q_ACK_TOLD.bt: Thank you, your reply has been delivered. If someone does not call or come within {minutes} minutes, go to {facility}. If you see a danger sign, go RIGHT NOW.
